description: This file defines the enum OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction and related nested structs, providing utility functions for handling UI actions, serialization, and message formatting within the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: An enum encapsulating UI action-related structures and static utility functions for processing actions, serializing data, and generating formatted messages.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts an action name string from a dictionary, considering multiple possible keys ('name' and 'action').

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Trims, normalizes, and sanitizes a string for safe use as a tag value, replacing disallowed characters with underscores.

methods.name: compactJSON
methods.description: Serializes an object to a compact JSON string if valid.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Creates a formatted string representing an agent message, incorporating context information and sanitized values.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet to dispatch a custom event indicating the status of an A2 UI action, with JSON payload containing action ID, success status, and error message.
